# Web Search API Eval

> A live, side-by-side benchmark of four web search APIs for AI agents (You.com, Tavily, Exa and Parallel) on 30 agent-style queries across GTM, insurance and finance use cases. Final run Oct 8, 2026, by Pallavi Singla. Results are a published snapshot, not live data. Anyone can rerun the harness with their own API keys; nothing runs on a hosted server.

Headline: You.com is the fastest API tested and the most dependable at returning something fresh (leads freshness, reliability and search-only speed). Parallel leads accuracy, with You.com a close second and tied on fully correct queries. Exa returns the most on-topic top 5; Parallel is cheapest per correct answer.

Overall (90 calls per API): accuracy You.com 63%, Tavily 51%, Exa 53%, Parallel 67%; results inside the query's time window 59% / 37% / 44% / 29%; empty responses 0 / 27 / 12 / 3; client latency p50 593 / 1,864 / 1,106 / 2,038 ms; search cost per correct answer $0.026 / $0.016 / $0.012 / $0.008.

## Use it from an AI assistant

- MCP server (read-only, no sign-in, Streamable HTTP): https://websearch-api-eval.psberkeleymba.workers.dev/mcp. Tools: get_overall_results, get_scorecard, compare_providers, recommend_provider, list_questions, get_question, get_charts, get_methodology, how_to_run_locally, search, fetch. [Docs](https://github.com/psinglap/websearch-api-eval/tree/main/mcp)

## Results and data (JSON, same numbers as the site)

- [Overall and per-use-case results](https://psinglap.github.io/websearch-api-eval/data/results.json): headline, overall scorecard, per-use-case scorecards, which API fits which agent, developer activation
- [The 30 questions](https://psinglap.github.io/websearch-api-eval/data/questions.json): task, search call, parameters, answer key, sources, what each API returned and its score (0-2)
- [Methodology](https://psinglap.github.io/websearch-api-eval/data/methodology.json): how tests ran, the 10 metrics and the benchmarks they follow (SimpleQA, FreshQA, TREC-style relevance, htmldate)
- [Charts](https://psinglap.github.io/websearch-api-eval/data/charts.json): titles, captions and image links for every published graph
- [How to run it yourself](https://psinglap.github.io/websearch-api-eval/data/run_locally.json): setup steps and the API keys you need

## Pages

- [Evaluation](https://psinglap.github.io/websearch-api-eval/): every query, answer key, what each API returned, per-use-case scorecards and the setup friction log
- [GTM memo](https://psinglap.github.io/websearch-api-eval/memo/): which web search API should power a live GTM chat agent
- [Target accounts](https://psinglap.github.io/websearch-api-eval/accounts/): 60 accounts across 6 agent use cases, GTM plays and distribution
- [Search Atlas](https://psinglap.github.io/websearch-api-eval/atlas/): the six ways AI products get web search, market size today and in 2030, how to win
